output.title: HTTP01 Ingress challenge paths now use PathType Exact (breaking change)
output.content: The release notes flag as a breaking change that ACME HTTP01 Ingress challenges now use `PathType` `Exact`, and say it is incompatible with certain ingress setups. The environment's values set `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, which suggests HTTP-01 challenges are in scope, though no Issuer or Ingress manifest is shown. Inspect whether any issuer uses an HTTP01 Ingress solver and whether your ingress controller handles `Exact` paths for the challenge route. The excerpt is truncated, so read the full note for the incompatibility conditions.
